title: ECIDÉ march in Goma against insecurity and Minembwe/balkanization measures
location: Goma, North Kivu; local venue/site not established beyond ECIDÉ/party office mention in search-only result
size_reported: Unknown in accessible opened report. MediaCongo search response claimed about fifty at the ECIDÉ office, but its exact page and Actu7 exact page both returned 403; this claim is not treated as independently verified.

action.summary: Grands Lacs News states the ECIDÉ march was stopped/dispersed; no headcount or exact gathering boundary.

demand.summary: Opposition to Minembwe commune appointment and balkanization; exact policy rationale requires independent review.

threshold.summary: No accessible body reports a same-site count. Search-only MediaCongo result claims about fifty at the party office; actual target denied.

state_response.summary: Grands Lacs News says police intervened and dispersed participants.

provenance.summary: Grands Lacs article provenance beyond publisher unknown; search-only MediaCongo attributes to Congo Synthèse/MCP. Dependence not established.

title: ECIDÉ march in Beni with memorandum delivered to urban authority
location: Rond-point ENRA to Beni city hall, Beni, North Kivu
size_reported: Organizer described a massive public response; no numerical turnout reported.

action.summary: Radio Okapi reports an executed peaceful march and delivery of a memorandum at Beni city hall.

demand.summary: Opposed balkanization/territorial appropriation and demanded evaluation of state Operation Sokola 1 in North Kivu.

threshold.summary: Only the ECIDÉ federation president's qualitative statement that the population came massively; no count or second witness.

location.summary: Route starts at ENRA roundabout and ends at city hall.

state_response.summary: March was escorted by Congolese National Police; no state response dimensions otherwise reported.

title: Fayulu/Lamuka march in Kinshasa stopped and dispersed by police
location: Kinshasa, Place Pascal/commune of Masina toward Matete bridge and Limete; exact route beyond obstruction point uncertain
size_reported: No count. Actualité.cd reports Fayulu with some party supporters and that police deployment prevented mobilization from growing.

action.summary: Radio Okapi reports march began at Place Pascal and was stopped by Matete bridge; Actualité.cd describes the initial gathering as a small set near Fayulu and security prevented growth.

demand.summary: Reported aim was national unity/territorial integrity and opposition to Minembwe commune appointment; state-policy target needs review.

threshold.summary: No quantitative count; contemporaneous source says only some militants and mobilization had difficulty growing.

state_response.summary: Police used tear gas to disperse march; a vehicle tire was damaged.

title: Secondary teachers march in Mbuji-Mayi over unpaid public-school teacher salaries
location: Mbuji-Mayi, Kasaï-Oriental; exact route/site not reported
size_reported: Nearly fifty teachers reported; wording does not establish at least fifty.

action.summary: Radio Okapi reports secondary teachers were in the streets and other teacher unions joined the march.

demand.summary: Participants demanded removal of the national EPST minister and SECOPE director over nonpayment of new-unit teachers.

threshold.summary: Source says nearly fifty, an ambiguous figure around but not clearly above the 50 threshold.

location.summary: Mbuji-Mayi city; per-site precise route unknown.

title: Kalemie students march for resumption of classes during teachers' strike
location: Place Maendeleo to the provincial Ministry of Interior and Security, Kalemie, Tanganyika
size_reported: About one hundred students from two named Catholic schools reported.

action.summary: Election-net reports an executed march; its report says it observed the event.

demand.summary: Students sought immediate class resumption, invoked constitutional right to education, and asked the provincial authority for a solution.

threshold.summary: Source reports about one hundred students in one march/site.

state_response.summary: Provincial Interior/Security minister addressed students and cited an upcoming education-government-parent meeting to seek a solution.

continuity.summary: Occurred amid teachers' strike that began at the Oct12 school-year start; Catholic-school classes resumed Nov2 after strike suspension.

title: Search-only report of Kinshasa students in the street over class resumption
location: Kinshasa; site/route unknown in returned search result
size_reported: Unknown; exact Actu7 page request returned 403.

action.summary: Search result title reports students in the street to demand classes resume; exact body not obtained after 403.

threshold.summary: No count or same-site details in retained search result.

demand.summary: Education demands evident in headline; whether directed to state or school bodies unresolved.

access.summary: Exact target returned actual 403 Forbidden; no retry or bypass.
